subject: Re: Proposal: Co-branded Technical Workshop Series — MDF, stipends, and staffing
messages:
From: Susan Kim <susan.kim@edgebridge.com>

Cc: partner_ops@edgebridge.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 12:15:00 -0400
Subject: Proposal: Co-branded Technical Workshop Series (US West + East)

Hi Mina —

EdgeBridge is interested in running a co-branded, hands-on technical workshop series with Redwood in Q3. Target: two cities (SF Bay Area and NYC), one day each, 40–60 seats per city. Goals are pipeline acceleration + hands-on product experience for mid-market prospects.

We talked internally and would like to propose the following high-level items for discussion:
- Redwood provides 2 instructors per city + one remote backup (Redwood to staff out).
- EdgeBridge will handle local venue logistics, refreshments, and attendee registration.
- MDF request: $35k total to cover joint marketing, travel stipends for selected attendees, and instructor travel.
- Travel stipends: $150 travel credit for distributed customers to encourage in-person attendance.
- Co-branded registration page + joint email cadence (3 emails).

Attached is a short SOW and a starter MDF termsheet. Can we set a sync for next week to align on scope, timelines, and PO timing?

Thanks —
Susan
Partnerships Lead, EdgeBridge

Attachments referenced: EB_Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, Draft_MDF_Termsheet.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Co-branded Technical Workshop Series (US West + East)

Susan —

Really appreciate the clear proposal. Redwood is excited to run this. Quick notes from our side:

- Instructors: we can commit 2 on-site engineers per city plus one remote shadow. I'll confirm names (likely internal SEs) by 05/01.
- MDF: $35k is within range; need to align on breakup (marketing vs travel stipends vs onsite ops). Suggest: $18k marketing, $10k stipends, $7k ops (AV/handouts).
- Travel stipends: we prefer issuing stipends as a credit code applied at registration rather than cash reimbursement — easier for accounting.
- Registration: Redwood can host the co-branded page; Marissa will handle the email nurture.
- PO timing: EdgeBridge PO + SOW signed by 06/01 to ensure travel bookings and print materials by mid-June.

Can we do a 30-min sync Thu 04/22 at 10am PT?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
